 set local-preference 990
 set metric 5
 set community  1:100 additive
exit
!
no access-list 151
access-list 151 permit ip 10.2.0.0   0.0.0.0   255.255.0.0   0.0.0.0

!

 match ip address 152
exit
!
router bgp 1
!
 neighbor 10.0.0.2 remote-as 2
 neighbor 10.0.0.2 route-map AS2-IN-1 in
!
exit

!

 match ip address 152
exit
!
no ip as-path access-list  50
ip as-path access-list 50 permit ^_4(_(1|10|11|12|14))*$
!
ip bgp-community new-format
!
no ip community-list 50
ip community-list 50 permit 4:1 
!
route-map AS4-IN-3 permit 2
 match as-path 50
 match community 50
exit
!
router bgp 1
!
 neighbor 10.0.0.4 remote-as 4
 neighbor 10.0.0.4 route-map AS4-IN-3 in
!
exit

 match ip address 152

 match ip address 155
 set as-path prepend 1 1

!
no ip community-list 51
ip community-list 51 deny 5:666
ip community-list 51 permit internet

 match community 51
 set as-path prepend 1 1

 neighbor 10.0.0.5 remote-as 5
 neighbor 10.0.0.5 route-map AS5-IN-4 in
